content: Hello! You've reached HR payroll support. How can I assist you with your account or payment today?
Hi, this is Kevin Lin, employee ID 458027. I wanted to double-check that my salary for June was sent to my new Bank of America account.

Thank you, Kevin. I see your payroll update came through last week, and your June salary, $3,950, was processed on June 28th to account ending in 7631, under the name Kevin Lin. The direct deposit reference is BOA-PAY-20230628-2217.
Perfect, thanks for confirming. Will this affect my tax document delivery address? My address is 412 Willow Rd, Apt 3C, San Mateo, CA 94401.

Your address is correctly listed as 412 Willow Rd, Apt 3C, San Mateo, CA 94401 in our HR system. No action needed on your end, your W-2 will be mailed there by January 31. If you need electronic copies, your email kevin.lin.hr@eastsidegroup.com is on file.
That's great. I just noticed a pending deposit alert from Bank of America today, does that match the payroll timeline?
Yes, that's expected. Bank of America's processing time is usually under 24 hours, so the deposit tagged as BOA-PAY-20230628-2217 should clear by end of business today.
Awesome. Just to confirm, the old Wells Fargo account ending 1987 is no longer active for payroll, right?

Correct. All payroll after June 15 is directed only to your Bank of America account ending in 7631. The Wells Fargo account ending 1987 was removed per your update on June 12, no payments will be sent there going forward.
